Gives the projection matrix of a camera, in the convention of [SetCameraProjectionMatrix](SetCameraProjectionMatrix). Without a matrix of its own, it is the one that [CameraZoom](CameraZoom), [CameraRange](CameraRange) and [CameraProjMode](CameraProjMode) make for the size of the camera's viewport. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.
@param camera  Camera handle.
@returns The projection matrix.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
camera = CreateCamera()
CameraZoom camera, 2
Local m:FloatMatrix4x4 = GetCameraProjectionMatrix(camera)
Print m[0][0] ; 2.0
```
